- Implement the requirement FAITHFULLY and COMPLETELY, matching how the real upstream Jenkins change would look. Match surrounding code style, imports, javadoc conventions, and licence headers.
- ONLY modify the files listed in "ALLOWED FILES" below (you may create new files listed there). Do NOT touch any other file. Other agents are working on other files concurrently.

- Do NOT create or edit files under /workspace/requirement_patches or /workspace/agent_plans.
- If a message resource string is needed, add it to the appropriate Messages.properties file (if that file is in your allowed list).

Return a SHORT report: list of files changed/created, and 1-3 sentences per file describing the change. Do not paste large diffs.


SLUG: zip-installer-non-http-urls
ALLOWED FILES:
 - /workspace/core/src/main/java/hudson/tools/ZipExtractionInstaller.java

IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE:
JENKINS-75003: in the doCheckUrl form validation, when the URI scheme is not http/https, accept the value if Path.of(uri) (java.nio.file.Path) resolves without throwing; only report the existing malformed-URL error when it throws (InvalidPathException / IllegalArgumentException). Keep the HTTP(S) reachability checks unchanged.

1	title: '[JENKINS-75003] Zip-based tool installer configuration incorrectly rejects non-HTTP(S) URLs (regression in 2.379)'
2	category: bugfix
3	requirement: '## Context
4	
5	  A Jenkins administrator configuring a zip-based tool installer may point it at a local filesystem URI or another non-HTTP(S) source, but Jenkins now rejects those values even when they are valid paths, breaking configurations that used to work.
6	
7	
8	  ## Desired outcome
9	
10	  `ZipExtractionInstaller` validation should accept non-HTTP(S) URIs whenever `Path.of(uri)` can resolve them successfully, while continuing to reject malformed values. Administrators should be able to save valid local or other path-backed URIs instead of being forced onto HTTP-only configuration.
11	
12	
13	  ## Acceptance signals
14	
15	  Valid non-HTTP(S) URIs that can be converted with `Path.of(uri)` pass installer validation, malformed non-HTTP(S) values still fail with the normal malformed-URL error, and previously working local URI-based installers can be configured again.
16	
17	  '
